facts: Rock star Ozzy Osborne saved his wife Sharon’s Pomeranian from a coyote by tackling and wresting the coyote until it released the dog.
A puppy is born blind, deaf, and toothless.
Dogs can see in color, though they most likely see colors similar to a color-blind human. They can see better when the light is low.
Dogs curl up to keep themselves warm and protect vital organs.
The most intelligent breed of dog is the Border Collie.
